_notes.skipRepos: llm-memory is the memory vault. /wrap already commits it every session; a second writer invites conflicts. Remove it here if you want it swept too.
_notes.commitPreexistingDirty: false means the job commits ONLY files it changed itself. Your ~500 pre-existing dirty files stay dirty and are listed in the morning report. Setting this true would have the job commit your in-progress work unattended, which is the personal-data leak path flagged on 2026-08-06.
_notes.model: sonnet keeps 15 repos/night affordable on the subscription. Switch to opus if review depth matters more than throughput.
_notes.providerFailoverAgent: When Claude returns a provider availability, credential, quota, or weekly-limit failure before edits begin, this existing subscription-first adapter is invoked with the same prompt and repository. It must remain outside this public repository if its source lives in career-ops. A missing adapter is reported as a failed fallback, never as success.
_notes.nightlyCostCapUsd: Hard ceiling. The 2026-08-06 pilot measured $2.24 for one small repo (relocation-os, 14 turns), so an uncapped 14-repo run is roughly $31/night or $940/month IF it bills the metered API rather than the subscription. $12 covers about 5-6 repos a night; the repo order rotates daily so everything gets swept across a rota of roughly three nights. Raise it once you have confirmed from the Anthropic console that these runs are drawing the subscription.
_notes.globalDeadlineMs: 6h. Starting at 02:00 PT this hard-stops at 08:00 PT so the job is never still running when you sit down.
_notes.launchdLabel: Used by the once-per-day self-restart when the whole process tree loses file access. The 2026-08-07 incident was a runtime authorization failure bound to the running tree, not a revoked grant (the TCC record stayed allowed and untouched), so a fresh launchd process tree recovers it. Bounded by a self-restart-YYYY-MM-DD marker in logDir: a restart loop on a job that spends money is worse than a missed night.
